args.question:
Cobalt Labs (V-186) has TWO approved invoices, and you asked me to pay "the approved invoice" in full — I need to know which one (or both) you mean:

• INV-30444 — $3,714.45, due 2026-11-04
• INV-51862 — $6,764.82, due 2026-11-25

(For reference, also on file: INV-43342 — $3,629.40, status draft/"Awaiting approval"; and INV-84090 — $6,578.62, already marked paid.)

I won't pay anything until you confirm, so nothing gets paid twice or to the wrong invoice. Which invoice ID should I pay by wire?
